s1.syndrome_frame: a gradually enlarging, red, cutaneous tumor with a hard nodule on the upper arm
salient_findings: red tumor on the right upper arm
key_facts: 16-year-old girl
previously healthy
tumor enlarged over 6 months
no history of local trauma or insect bite
personal, past, and family histories were unremarkable
6 × 6-cm protuberant, thick-walled, and well-defined red tumor
nontender, firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor
normal laboratory tests
multilocular spaces below the epidermis on pathological examination
solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance

shortlist.label: pilomatrixoma
shortlist.why_kept: matches clinical description of a firm, hard nodule within a cutaneous tumor

shortlist.label: calcifying epithelioma of Malherbe
shortlist.why_kept: consistent with the pathological findings of a solid tumor with a chalky-white cut surface

shortlist.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
shortlist.why_kept: matches the description of a protuberant, thick-walled tumor

shortlist.label: keratoacanthoma
shortlist.why_kept: possible match for a rapidly growing, cutaneous tumor with a firm center

shortlist.label: glomus tumor
shortlist.why_kept: could explain the presence of a firm nodule within a cutaneous tumor

raw.rationale: The presence of a firm-to-hard nodule inside the tumor, multilocular spaces below the epidermis, and a solid tumor in the deep dermis with a chalky-white cut surface and lobulated appearance on pathological examination are characteristic of pilomatrixoma. Additionally, the basophilic cells and shadow cells in the deep dermis are typical histological features of pilomatrixoma.

rejected.label: calcifying epithelioma of Malherbe
rejected.why: While calcifying epithelioma of Malherbe is another name for pilomatrixoma, the provided shortlist labels suggest selecting 'pilomatrixoma' as the champion diagnosis.

rejected.label: Dermatofibrosarcoma protuberans
rejected.why: This condition typically presents as a slowly growing, plaque-like lesion with a characteristic storiform pattern on histology, which does not match the described tumor's appearance and histological features.

rejected.label: keratoacanthoma
rejected.why: Keratoacanthoma usually presents as a solitary, firm, and dome-shaped nodule with a central crater, which is not consistent with the described tumor's appearance and growth pattern.

rejected.label: glomus tumor
rejected.why: Glomus tumors are typically small, blue-colored, and painful, which does not match the described tumor's size, color, and lack of tenderness.
